approval_note: all: every Short waits for Charlie's OK; flagged: only Shorts with a reason to look wait (the end goal); none: everything uploads straight away.
note: Uploads are capped by YouTube's channel limit: 10 in any 24 hours until the channel has Advanced features (video selfie). The API quota let 10 uploads through on 17 October, so it isn't the binding limit at 10 a day; ask Google for more quota (support.google.com/youtube/contact/yt_api_form) before going to 20. After Advanced features: daily_limit and per_session 20, slot_first 08:00, slot_every_minutes 45, slots_per_day 20, and a second writer run at 12:50.
